Private construction selects that existing member; copying preserves its identity/name and cannot manufacture another admitted member, a callable implementation, or consumed placement authority. This is reusable lookup metadata, not an executable function owner See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#closed-typed-output-boundary. Decoder/API acceptance and native behavior remain separate obligations; this is a construction-capability classification, not an executed proof.

This explicitly preserves repeatable decoding of the same captured data See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#numeric-ingress-defect.
